VBO:0200718.summary: Serious and watchful on its own ground, the Pastore Italiano is a guardian shaped by work with livestock in central Italy. Its selection centre describes a dog that patrols its territory yet stays close to its handler when away from home. Piero Accettella began selecting the population in 1975; it took its Italian Shepherd name in the 1990s.
VBO:0200718.shortDescription: A serious central Italian guardian that patrols its territory and stays close to its handler when away from home.

sources.title: Centro Cinofilo del Cane da Pastore Italiano — standard
sources.evidence: Serious watchful territorial guardian, constantly patrols territory and stays near handler away from its environment. Literal rectangular mature body, inward-tipped upright ears, straight strong forelimbs/powerful hindlimbs/open feet and long high-set preferably hooked natural tail. Child, lifespan, health and never-attacks guarantees excluded.

sources.title: Centro Cinofilo del Cane da Pastore Italiano — selection history
sources.evidence: Accettella began selecting regional central-Italian black livestock-working dogs about1975; named Cane da Pastore Italiano in1990s, current standard1997. No ancient unbroken breed, FCI/ENCI recognition or parent behavior transfer asserted.

VBO:0200281.summary: Loyal and inclined to stay near its handler, the Canis Panther is bred for watchfulness and personal protection. Its intended character combines attentiveness with patience and composure, although drives and reactions vary with the line and individual. The American project began around 1974, drawing together several working breeds rather than preserving one older breed unchanged.
VBO:0200281.shortDescription: A loyal, watchful American protection-dog project, intended to stay attentive to its handler with patience and composure.

sources.title: Federation of the Canis Panther — current2024 standard
sources.evidence: Loyal protective dog seeking owner/handler proximity; patience and bearing valued, personal-protection selection aims. Slightly longer-than-tall muscular adult, square strong muzzle, high-set cropped or uncropped ears, heavy straight long limbs/catfeet and short SINGLE coat. Docked second-joint tail preference disclosed, not copied or sufficient evidence of natural tail.

sources.title: Federation of the Canis Panther — history
sources.evidence: Project began about1974 with Jones/Lopez/Stratten selecting personal-protection dogs from several working founders. Individual accusations/medical history, uncertain founder percentages and ancient continuity omitted.

sources.title: Above & Beyond — original-line breeder standard
sources.evidence: Natural ears lie close to head with slightly blunt tips. Tail strong at root tapering toward end, neither too high nor too low set, slight upward curve in relaxed movement but never curled above topline. Not represented as federation consensus; source simultaneously maintains original2019 RockOfAges foundation and separately identified new Genesis program.

sources.title: Above & Beyond — original Canis Panther Toscana identity
sources.evidence: Explicit ORIGINAL CANIS PANTHER Toscana, Above&Beyond of RockOfAges, USA-born2019/direct2019 import; distinctly separates Pandora/new-line and Orange/Summer Genesis offspring. Mature-looking named original animal photograph used for developed head/front/trunk/coat only, no cropped-ear/tail copying.
